items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I play with, what you call, this boy, George Williams.

ctx.x: Play with John. I play with, what you call, this boy, George Williams. You know. Well, I tell you the truth, I'm going to be straight and tell you about them parades. That sun's been a little too hot, man. That didn't use me walking all that hot sun like that. It's hot in that sun, man.
